raw_segments.text: The evident justice and utility of the foregoing maxims have recommended them, more or less,
to the attention of all nations.
All nations have endeavored, to the best of their judgment, to render their taxes as equal
as they could contrive, as certain, as convenient to the contributor, both the time and the
mode of payment, and in proportion to the revenue which they brought to the prince,
as little burdensome to the people.
